title: Learning Not To Interfere: Adapting Experts For Model Merging
abstract: arXiv:2603.13467v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Model merging has shown that multitask models can be created by directly combining the parameters of different models that are each specialized on tasks of interest. However, models trained independently on distinct tasks often exhibit interference that degrades the merged model's performance. To solve this problem, we formally define the notion of Cross-Task Interference as the drift in the representation of the merged model relative to its constituent models. Reducing cross-task interference is key to improving merging performance. To address this issue, we propose our method, Resolving Interference (RI), a light-weight adaptation framework which disentangles expert models to be functionally orthogonal to the space of other tasks, thereby reducing cross-task interference. RI does this whilst using only unlabeled auxiliary data as input (i.e., no task-data is needed), allowing it to be applied in data-scarce scenarios. RI cons

translated_title: 学会不干扰：为模型合并适配专家模型
translated_abstract: 模型合并已经表明，可以通过直接组合不同模型的参数来创建多任务模型，其中每个模型分别专门针对感兴趣的任务进行训练。然而，在不同任务上独立训练的模型通常会表现出相互干扰，从而降低合并模型的性能。为了解决这个问题，我们正式定义了“跨任务干扰”的概念，即合并模型的表示相对于其组成模型所产生的漂移。减少跨任务干扰是提高合并性能的关键。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了我们的方法——干扰解决（Resolving Interference, RI），这是一个轻量级的适配框架，它将专家模型进行解耦，使其在功能上与其他任务的空间正交，从而减少跨任务干扰。RI 在实现这一目标的同时，仅使用未标记的辅助数据作为输入（即不需要任务数据），使其能够应用于数据稀缺的场景。
tldr: 本文提出了轻量级适配框架RI（干扰解决），通过将专家模型解耦为与其他任务空间功能正交的形式来减少模型合并中的跨任务干扰，且仅需未标记的辅助数据即可实现，适用于数据稀缺场景。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Resolving Interference (RI), a lightweight adaptation framework that disentangles expert models to be functionally orthogonal to other tasks' spaces, thereby reducing cross-task interference in model merging while requiring only unlabeled auxiliary data, making it applicable in data-scarce scenarios.
